about: The Sputnik DAO v2 contract the owner council runs (D81). This exact wasm is what the testnet factory sputnikv2.testnet deploys by default (get_default_code_hash, checked 2026-10-29), version 3.31. The sandbox tests download it from url, check sha256, and cache it under contracts/integration-tests/target/sputnik/. SPUTNIK_DAO_WASM=<path> overrides the download (offline runs); the file must still match sha256.
